word_family.gloss: 旧称中的多名麻风病患者
旧时收容麻风病患者的机构

senses.zh_definition: 旧时英语对麻风病患者的称呼；亦曾泛指患有被社会厌避的疾病的人，带有污名色彩。
senses.en_definition: A historical term for a person with leprosy, or more broadly someone with a disease regarded as repellent.
senses.ms_definition: Istilah lama bahasa Inggeris bagi penghidap kusta, atau secara lebih luas seseorang yang menghidap penyakit yang dipandang menjijikkan oleh masyarakat.
senses.nuances: 应限于历史文本释读，不能当作马来语日常称谓。下列ms为历史语境的翻译，未声称存在现代高频搭配；本条马来文释义是译释。[Merriam-Webster：lazar](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/lazar)

dual_scenarios.context: 历史文献 / 翻译说明；引用英语旧词
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam terjemahan manuskrip itu, istilah lama Inggeris lazar diterangkan sebagai penghidap kusta.
dual_scenarios.zh: 翻译该手稿时，英语旧词lazar被解释为麻风病患者。
dual_scenarios.en: In the manuscript's translation, the historical English term lazar is explained as a person with leprosy.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Lazar tu istilah lama je; sekarang sebut penghidap kusta.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Lazar itu istilah lama; sekarang kita menggunakan sebutan penghidap kusta.
dual_scenarios.zh: Lazar是旧称啦，现在说“麻风病患者”。
dual_scenarios.en: Lazar is an old term; nowadays we'd say a person with leprosy.

messages.en: I found lazar in this old book. Is it someone's name?

messages.speaker: Amir (同学)

messages.ms_standard: Lihat ayatnya dahulu. Jika perkataan itu istilah lama bahasa Inggeris, maksudnya penghidap kusta; jangan gunakannya sebagai panggilan kepada seseorang.
messages.zh: 先看句子。要是那个英语旧词，就是麻风病患者的意思，别拿来称呼别人啦。
messages.en: Check the sentence first. If it's the old English term, it means a person with leprosy. Don't use it to address someone.

etymology.historical_story: English lazar is recorded from the medieval period and derives through Medieval Latin lazarus from the name Lazarus. The name became associated with visibly diseased poverty through the biblical beggar. Its later use as a disease label illustrates how religious narrative could shape vocabulary, while also preserving attitudes that modern respectful language avoids. [Sources: Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/lazar), [Online Etymology Dictionary](https://www.etymonline.com/word/lazar)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把laz.ar连到名字Lazarus，再联想旧文献中的患病乞者；记住这是历史称呼，不是现代称呼患者的用语。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈及现实中的患者时，使用penghidap kusta或pesakit kusta，避免用这个历史标签直接称人。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合历史研究、文学注释和旧词翻译。若Lazar是具体人物的姓名，应尊重其姓名和本人读法，不附加疾病含义。
